expected_level_description: You can: - set up and lead a portfolio office for the organisation - give senior leaders clear, reliable insight into the portfolio - set project and portfolio management standards and tools
You can: - manage projects from start to close, controlling scope, time, cost, and quality - manage risks, issues, dependencies, and change control - report to project boards and manage suppliers
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
You can: - track spending against a small budget and raise variances - authorise spending within your limit
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - support committee meetings, papers, and minutes - keep governance registers up to date

You can: - understand the environment and prioritise the most important or high value tasks - use data to inform planning - manage complex internal and external dependencies - provide delivery confidence - remove blockers or impediments that affect plans and can develop a plan for difficult situations - ensure that teams plan appropriately for their capacity

You can: - identify important stakeholders and communicate with them clearly and regularly - tailor communication to stakeholders' needs and work with them to build relationships while meeting user needs - build and reach consensus with stakeholders - work to improve stakeholder relationships using evidence to explain decisions
